parameters.name: id
parameters.description: An upstream resource id (letters, digits, dot, underscore, dash; at most 128 characters).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: The page's key for one user submit: a fresh crypto.randomUUID() per submit, reused on retry. The BFF forwards to the upstream command a key minted from (route, subject, this key); the provider replays a retry and answers 409 idempotency-key-reused when the same key carries a different request. Missing: 400 idempotency-key-required; longer than 128 characters or not visible ASCII: 400 idempotency-key-invalid.
